name: Gio me
summary: Giò me, also giò bê, is a veal loaf in three layers: egg, a thin skin, then the meat. The meat is fragrant, soft, and not dry, the skin is crisp, and the sweetness is the veal’s own.
origin: Nghệ An. Vietnamnet and Trung tâm Thông tin du lịch both use giò me and giò bê. Neither prints a Vinh street.
texture: Vietnamnet says the outer layer is egg, then a thin veal skin, then the meat. The meat is soft and not dry. The skin is crisp.
taste: Vietnamnet says the meat is fragrant. Trung tâm Thông tin du lịch says the sweetness is the veal’s own.
howToEat: Slice it for a feast, Tết, a death anniversary, or a parcel, which is when Vietnamnet says it appears. The meat is soft and not dry, and the skin is crisp, on the Vietnamnet account. Trung tâm Thông tin du lịch says the taste is the sweetness of the veal. A street and a price were not printed. Check on arrival.
where: A street was not printed. Check on arrival.
